newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: Rice prices in the southern United States were mostly steady in the week ended July 5, USDA Market News said in its weekly review.
Long grain milled rice prices were selling mostly at $20.00 to $21.00 per cwt. andmedium grain traded mostly at $18.50 to $19.00.

Second heads were steady and brewers were steady. Rice by-products were lower, bran was steady to $7.00 lower, and millfeed was mostly steady to $5.00 lower except in Arkansas where prices were $1.00 higher.
In California, rice prices were steady with medium grain selling mostly from $18.00 to $19.00, second heads were steady, and bran was $3.00 to $4.00 lower.
California rice ship loadings and rice inspections for the week ending July 5, 1997 were nil, USDA said..
The yearly total of inspections since October 1, 1996 is 9,706,850 cwt compared to 6,992,387 cwt a year ago.
